{
    "sla_rules": [
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_001",
            "metric": "DaysToHire",
            "threshold": 30.0,
            "threshold_operator": ">",
            "penalty_amount": 500,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 5,
            "description": "5% penalty if hiring takes more than 30 days",
            "applicable_period": "per incident"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_002",
            "metric": "FirstSessionSatisfaction",
            "threshold": 8.0,
            "threshold_operator": "<",
            "penalty_amount": 300,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 3,
            "description": "3% penalty if first session satisfaction is below 8",
            "applicable_period": "per incident"
        }
    ],
    "violation_conditions": [
        {
            "metric": "DaysToHire",
            "condition": "DaysToHire > 30",
            "penalty_rule": "5% penalty if hiring takes more than 30 days"
        },
        {
            "metric": "FirstSessionSatisfaction",
            "condition": "FirstSessionSatisfaction < 8",
            "penalty_rule": "3% penalty if first session satisfaction is below 8"
        }
    ],
    "sql_query": "SELECT IncidentID, CASE WHEN DaysToHire > 30 THEN 500 ELSE 0 END AS PenaltyDaysToHire, CASE WHEN FirstSessionSatisfaction < 8 THEN 300 ELSE 0 END AS PenaltyFirstSessionSatisfaction FROM incidents_trainer_hiring",
    "data_fields_required": ["IncidentID", "DaysToHire", "FirstSessionSatisfaction"],
    "monthly_service_fee": 10000,
    "max_monthly_penalty_percentage": 30
}
